a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs at least 2 operate rounds before anyone holds cells, so we would both very likely die. I plan to take 4 in round 1. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you'd prefer, we can both take and let the split fall where it does.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. If a storm doesn't hit and the generator can still refill the reserve for you, I'll operate with you so you can get your 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
